name: Keom kNative redeemUnderlying caps burned shares without recomputing the payout
summary: In Keom's Compound-V2-fork kNative market, redeemFresh (via redeemUnderlying) caps the shares to burn at the redeemer's balance but keeps paying the caller-requested underlying amount; with the market exited, redeemAllowed skips the liquidity check. The attacker minted 4,918,683 kNative for 0.001 ETH, exited the market and redeemed the market's entire 38.60 ETH cash while burning only those shares.

loss.notes: The kNative market's entire pre-exploit ETH balance (eth_getBalance 38600532887381810523 wei at block 30488584, 0 at 30488585); the attacker's own 0.001 ETH mint, returned inside the 38.601532887381810523 ETH redemption, is not counted. Polygon zkEVM ETH valued at the Ethereum WETH DefiLlama quote. BlockSec's roundup states about $35K; the onchain amount at the contemporaneous ETH price is higher.

ageReset.description: Timelock-executed batch (0xbc1c65364efec2f204019c949cf389f6e610e0d4, called through multiSend by 0x7a10033f) upgraded the kNative proxy from 0x6ad33c60da59f01a3085fd5634b89b852a4224b2 to 0xf7faa3f1; earlier implementations were 0x4c6e83b9f7e8835f583be748de899c5881fbc403 (to block 8564691) and 0x6ad33c60.

limitations: Declared anchors and execution relationship now reproduce, but source-10 exercises a similar capped redemption in an earlier implementation. Whether upgrades fixed and reintroduced the fault or retained one episode is unresolved (source-9); the 2026 anchor and age are not admitted.

sources.note: Evidence gathered through https://zkevm-rpc.com (eth_* only). Source-1 receipt (block 30488585, index 0, contract creation by EOA 0xb343fe12f86f785a88918599b29b690c4a5da6d5 with value 0.002 ETH, creating 0x5a2f4151ea961d3dfc4ddf116ca95bfa5865f16f): log 0 AccrueInterest on the market; log 1 comptroller 0x6ea32f626e3a5c41547235ebbdf861526e11f482 MarketEntered(market, attacker); log 2 Mint(attacker, 0.001 ETH, 4918683 kNative); log 4 MarketExited(market, attacker); log 5 Transfer(attacker -> market, 4918683); log 6 Redeem(attacker, 38601532887381810523 wei, 4918683). At the mint's exchange rate 4918683 shares are worth 0.001 ETH, so the redemption pays 38,601x the burned shares' value. First exercise: eth_getLogs Redeem (topic 0xe5b754fb...) on the market in 10,000-block windows from block 9387684 to 30488585 returns 35,748 events; excluding zero redemptions the amount/tokens ratio is about 2.0e8 wei per share unit for all others (maximum 2.58e8, dust) and 7.85e12 only in source-1. Artifact: the market 0xee1727f5 is an EIP-1967 proxy (runtime keccak256 0x25e162d5fc353a9207fb4de485b4f3e0cb78ef7710ed65834dba5a368eea7324 at blocks 108 and 30488584, empty at 107; created in 0x82f309e7d957c91d9a6effa7c8c196f4e235fb7e00f580f65814a192c6725351 at block 108 index 0 by 0x7a10033fb8f474f28c66cab7578f4af9e6dad37d; admin slot 0x367b17a6bcd9f6d9d04b6907c251dc4126c62b22). Bisection of the implementation slot between blocks 108 and 30488584 finds two changes: 8564691 (0x4c6e83b9 -> 0x6ad33c60) and 9387684 (0x6ad33c60 -> 0xf7faa3f1; source-2 receipt log 1 is Upgraded with topic1 0xf7faa3f1). Implementation 0xf7faa3f1 was created in source-7 (block 9387573, index 0, by 0x7a10033f); eth_getCode 0x at 9387572, keccak256 0x6545738130f3446d5e260f88ea1832558df5ace29485251751f234f7bef2f9fa at 9387573 and 30488584.

Loss: eth_getBalance(0xee1727f5074e747716637e1776b7f7c7133f16b1) = 38600532887381810523 wei at block 30488584 and 0 at 30488585; the attacker EOA's balance rises from 0.005 to 38.60552388677181 ETH. Valued at USD 2310.3999179758125 (source-6).

Partial follow-up; no promotion. https://zkevm-rpc.com now reproduces trace_transaction(source-1): frame [3,0] DELEGATECALLs 0xf7faa3f1 with redeemUnderlying selector 0x852a12e3 and requested 38601532887381810523 wei; [3,0,0] redeemAllowed receives 189868728525 shares, [3,0,1] redeemVerify receives only 4918683 shares and the unchanged payout, and [3,0,2] transfers that ETH amount. Receipt log 6 matches exactly; prior source-3 decimal transcription corrected. cast disassemble of the declared runtime shows totalSupply subtraction at PC 0x4234 before the account-balance cap at 0x42e9-0x432c; the cap changes memory offset 0x60 (shares), while offset 0x80 (payout) continues unchanged through Redeem and doTransferOut at 0x4523. Repository verifier reproduces all declared anchors using RPC_URL_FOR_CHAIN_1101=https://zkevm-rpc.com. Full eth_getLogs scan on the proxy, blocks 108-30488585 in nonoverlapping 10000-block windows, topics Upgraded(address) and Redeem(address,uint256,uint256): 3 upgrades at 108, 8564691 and 9387684; 114065 redemptions, including 35748 under the current implementation. Current implementation has only source-1 disproportionate redemption (next-largest amount/shares ratio 257749365.33333334 wei). But source-10 at block 4124067 index 0, before either upgrade, successfully requests 20000068377799950 wei with 98855176 computed shares, then caps to 112 in redeemVerify and receipt Redeem log 1. Previous-block exchangeRateStored() is 202316855040267849145937699, so 112 shares were worth about 22659487764 wei. It executes earlier runtime 0x4c6e83b9f7e8835f583be748de899c5881fbc403 (hash 0x45a027901762cfb28dd5234a1d70948d7aecfdf4a2619fcd8f3c2646c75fe126). Unresolved: whether the same capping fault persisted through both upgrades, requiring a merged episode anchored on source-10 or an even earlier exercise. Next: compare redeemFresh in all three runtimes, examine preceding redemptions for excessive payout relative to historical exchangeRateStored/account balance, and reconstruct old-episode victim loss before renaming the anchor or admitting a curve knot.

limitations: Earliest successful exercise and episode scope unresolved: source-10 exercised the earlier implementation in 2023 (source-9). Loss currently measures only the 2026 drain.
